sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 5 月 29 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：DELL、ASTS、MU、BO、SMCI。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今天的三个主要故事情节：

  1. Blue Origin "New Glenn" rocket exploded during an overnight ground test (Cape Canaveral, evening of 5/28, no casualties). It was originally scheduled for an Amazon Leo satellite launch in June. The event directly triggered a sell-off across the entire space sector—ASTS led the decline, plunging ~18% pre-market, with RKLB/LUNR/PL/JOBY/ACHR falling in sync by 9%–16%. Deutsche Bank noted that without New Glenn, it is difficult for ASTS to meet its target of ~45 satellites in 2026, and network deployment may slip to 2027 Q1.
  2. DELL earnings explosion after hours: AI server revenue +757% YoY to $16.1B, EPS $4.86 (vs. $2.94 expected), full-year guidance raised to $167B (including $60B in AI servers), stock jumped up to 39% to $441 after hours. After opening 40%–44% higher, it retreated to +31%–32%, marking another "high open, low close" scenario.
  3. US–Iran interim agreement: Both sides reached an MOU for a 60-day ceasefire and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, but it still awaits Trump's signature. A mid-session report of "Trump says no deal" caused oil prices to dip by about 1%.

指数层面的表现依然相当“温和”：5月28日，标普500指数收于7,563点（+0.58%），纳指收于26,917点（+0.91%），尽管PCE触及三年高位，但双双创下新高； 5月29日盘前，标普500指数仅上涨0.16%，SPY在757-760点之间呈“V”形振荡。

社区氛围：极度贪婪，近乎狂热（贪婪指数估计约为 90，高于之前的 88）。然而，这与实际指数“缓慢而稳定”的上涨形成鲜明对比——WSB将每1%的波动视为登月任务或崩溃，饲料中充斥着0DTE、“V型复苏”和“免费资金”。值得注意的是，在狂欢的背后，存在着一种前所未有的自嘲泡沫意识：“这是欣快的阶段”，“我需要一场崩盘和此后失去的十年”，“最不可持续的狗屎”，“家庭借钱买股票”——认知失调是严重的。 WSB 的情绪远比基本面或指数本身更为极端。
